files.description: This test file covers the photo gallery feature. It includes tests for verifying that images load correctly without broken links, that filtering by year functions as expected, and that pagination controls (next, first, last) work correctly.

testContext: The tests rely on the following selectors: `.photo-grid` for the main gallery container, `.photo-card` for individual photo items, `select#year-select` for the year filter, and standard role locators for buttons and links like `getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply Filters' })` and `getByRole('link', { name: 'Next ›' })`. The tests assume there is enough sample data to span multiple pages when the page size is set to 10 and that there are multiple years of photos available for filtering.
explanation: I have corrected the TypeScript compilation error. The Playwright `expect` library does not have a `toHaveCountGreaterThan` matcher for locators. I have replaced the incorrect line `await expect(page.locator('.photo-card')).toHaveCountGreaterThan(0);` with the correct pattern: first, get the count of the elements, and then use the standard `toBeGreaterThan` matcher on the resulting number. The corrected code is `const photoCount = await page.locator('.photo-card').count(); expect(photoCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);`. The rest of the generated test code remains the same as it was logically correct.
